annotations.title: Edit or remove a site section

description: Changes one node of a site - text, title, styling, link, image, heading level - or removes it and its descendants when remove is true. Address a section with section_id (from list_sections) or index, then aim at the node inside it with field (e.g. "heading", "body", "items[1].title"); list_sections shows every section's fields. Text goes on text nodes only: content aimed at a container is refused with the right field names. Free, and no account is needed for a draft you created.

add_item.description: Adds one card to the addressed section (services, features, pricing, products, testimonials...), styled like its last card. Fields not given are left out. The response gives its item number.

alt.description: New alt text for an image section.

band.description: Games list section only: its band. match (default) = the page's own look; light or dark forces a readable light or dark band.

class_name.description: New Tailwind class string for this section.

content.description: New text content for this section.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

field.description: Which node inside the addressed section to change, from that section's fields in list_sections: "heading", "body", "text[n]", "links[n]", "image", "items[n].title", "items[n].body", "items[n].price", "items[n].link", "items[n].image". A card with no link or photo yet: set field "items[n].link" with href (and optional content as the label) or "items[n].image" with src, and it is created. "items[n]" addresses the whole card (use with remove: true to delete one card). Omit to change the addressed node itself.

heading_class.description: Games list section only: heading classes (sizes, weights, uppercase, tracking, padding, rounding, alignment; no colours), e.g. the page's pill style 'inline-block rounded-full px-4 py-1 text-sm font-semibold uppercase'. Default: copied from the page's other headings.

heading_style.description: Games list section only: plain (default) = the heading takes the page's heading layout, never its colours; match = it also copies the page's pill colours (background and text) from its other section headings, only when they read at 4.5:1 or more. A page with no such coloured heading is unchanged.

href.description: New link target (http:, https:, mailto:, tel:, a path starting with /, or an in-page anchor like #pricing).

html_id.description: New HTML id for the node (e.g. "contact" for #contact anchor links).

index.description: The section (or node) index to edit or remove. Indices SHIFT/renumber whenever an earlier section is removed elsewhere on the page, so an index recorded before a removal may now point at a different section. Prefer section_id; call list_sections first (or after any removal) to get each section's CURRENT index and its stable section_id, which never changes. Give index, section_id, or both (they must agree).

level.description: New heading level (1-6) when this section is a heading textBox.

page.description: Which page of the site, as its path ("/about", "/contact"). Omit for the home page. See list_pages.

remove.description: When true, removes this section and its descendants instead of editing it (with field "items[n]": removes that one card).

section_id.description: The stable id of the section to address, exactly as list_sections returns it (e.g. "about-1"). It survives removals, unlike index. This ADDRESSES a section; it does not rename anything (use html_id for that).

site_key.description: The site to edit. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

src.description: New image/media source (same URL scheme rules as href).

stage.description: true = work on a staged copy instead of the live site: preview it at staged_preview_url, then publish_staged or discard_staged. Omit for a normal (immediately live) edit.

title.description: New title attribute for this section.

name: edit_section
title: Edit or remove a site section
